description: This Java class 'DefaultMailService' implements email sending functionalities for the Thingsboard platform, including configuration management, templated email generation, rate limiting, and timeout handling.

classes.name: DefaultMailService
classes.description: Implementation of MailService providing email functionalities with configuration, templating, rate limiting, and timeout handling.

methods.name: updateMailConfiguration
methods.description: Loads and applies mail configuration from admin settings.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Sends a simple email with specified subject and message.

methods.name: sendTestMail
methods.description: Sends a test email using provided JSON configuration.

methods.name: sendActivationEmail
methods.description: Sends an account activation email with a link and TTL.

methods.name: sendAccountActivatedEmail
methods.description: Sends an email indicating account activation.

methods.name: sendResetPasswordEmail
methods.description: Sends a password reset email with a link and TTL.

methods.name: sendResetPasswordEmailAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a password reset email.

methods.name: sendPasswordWasResetEmail
methods.description: Sends an email confirming password reset.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends an email based on TbEmail object for given tenant and customer.

methods.name: send(TenantId, CustomerId, TbEmail, JavaMailSender, long)
methods.description: Internal method to send email with custom mail sender and timeout.

methods.name: sendMail
methods.description: Prepares and sends email message with timeout handling.

methods.name: sendMailWithTimeout
methods.description: Handles sending email with timeout and exception management.

methods.name: mergeTemplateIntoString
methods.description: Processes a FreeMarker template into a string with provided model.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Converts exceptions into ThingsboardException with logging.
